Intro: Your establishment has been remarkably compliant with new safety protocols regarding Spoilage.
My officers have been singing your praises. I've come to see for myself, and to try some of your cooking.
Your identification of those who are Spoiled has been so accurate, I half-considered offering you a position in my ranks.
Though I'm sure your adoring customers would submit complaints if I whisked their beloved chef away to the military.
Your adherence to the rules is truly remarkable. People like you will never stray from the status quo.
I congratulate you on your success, and wish you many more years of happiness.
